subject: Re: Hosted API commit activation & rate-band clarification for ScalePath
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marta Rios <marta@scalepath.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@scalepath.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Aug 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API commit increase — proposed activation steps

Hi Marta / Ethan,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited about ScalePath's plan to accelerate usage over the next two quarters. Per our conversation, I'm proposing the following: a move from your current 1.5M token monthly commit to a 3.5M token monthly commit, applied to the Hosted API with a 12‑month term and a 10% committed discount to the standard hosted rate.

Key items I want to align on before we push to procurement:
- Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lists milestones and deployment dates (I attached a draft).
- Confirmation on rate-band expectations & burst window (we recommend a 20% burst cushion for the first 90 days).
- SOW signoff for onboarding work (small ops uplift to configure caching and batch settings).

If that looks good I'll loop in Grace from CS to propose a rollout calendar and Aditya to confirm any commercial approvals required for the billing amendment. Would you prefer a single SOW covering both onboarding and a short optimization engagement, or two separate docs?

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: ScalePath_MutualActionPlan_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf (proposal)
From: Marta Rios <marta@scalepath.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@scalepath.com>, procurement@scalepath.com
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit increase — proposed activation steps

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifying asks from our side: 

1) Can you confirm the monthly committed price per 1k tokens you quoted during the call and show the math for the 10% discount? Procurement needs a line-item.
2) We need hard limits for rate limiting — what are the per-minute TPS ceilings for the 3.5M commit and the burst cushion you mentioned?
3) On SOW: prefer a single SOW that includes a short optimization block (2 weeks) so we don't run two separate PO flows.

I'll share this with procurement and loop in our finance lead unless you want to send the commercial summary directly to procurement@scalepath.com.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Rios
Head of Engineering, ScalePath
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marta Rios <marta@scalepath.com>, procurement@scalepath.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit increase — proposed activation steps

Hi Marta / procurement team —

Thanks — answering inline and attaching a one‑pager commercial summary for procurement to consume:

1) Pricing math (monthly commit = 3.5M tokens):
- Standard hosted rate: $0.008 per 1k tokens
- Committed discount (10%): $0.0072 per 1k tokens
- Monthly committed spend (3.5M tokens): 3,500 * $0.0072 = $25,200 per month
- Annual committed ARR: $25,200 * 12 = $302,400

2) Rate limits & burst:
- Baseline sustained capacity: 110 tokens/sec (equivalent to steady-state throughput tuned for your request size).
- Soft burst window: +20% for 90 days (so short bursts up to ~132 tokens/sec).
- Hard throttle: 2x baseline (220 tokens/sec) to protect shared runtime during extreme spikes — we recommend application-side retry/backoff in that range.

3) SOW: agree to a single SOW. The attached Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf includes a 2-week optimization block and a 4-week onboarding schedule.

Next steps I propose:
- Procurement: confirm billing contact & PO process, then sign the commercial one‑pager I attached.
- Marta / Grace: align on target activation date — earliest we can start onboarding is Sept 5, assuming procurement paperwork completes next week.

I've attached: Redwood_Commercial_Summary_SP4821.pdf (one-pager) and updated MAP. Also adding Grace to coordinate schedule.

Cheers,
Ben

---
On Wed, Aug 22, 2028 at 08:45 AM Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com> wrote: (see below)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Marta Rios <marta@scalepath.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit increase — proposed activation steps

Hi Marta — great to meet you (virtually). Quick note on onboarding and the ops plan:

- Week 0 (pre-activation): confirm API keys, tagging, and dev/staging routing; we will provision a dedicated API key scoped to your commit and set up token usage reporting.
- Week 1: configure KV/prefix caching and batching profiles; Grace (me) will run a 2-hour baseline tuning session with your infra team.
- Week 2-3: monitor traffic with a canary ramp to the committed rate (we usually do a 3-step ramp: 30% / 60% / 100%).
- Ops guardrails: automatic fallback to smaller quantized model variants if latency exceeds 350ms P95 for more than 10 minutes.

For rate-limits: we can set both per-key soft limits (alerts at 80% utilization) and hard limits that return 429 when exceeded. I'll coordinate with Ben on the exact numbers to match your expected request size.

If you can confirm a preferred kickoff date, I'll send a proposed calendar and invite the relevant SRE folks.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Marta Rios <marta@scalepath.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@scalepath.com, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@scalepath.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit increase — proposed activation steps

Hi Ben / Grace — thanks for the detail and the attachments. Procurement is asking for the DocuSign link for the commercial cover sheet and the SOW consolidated into a single signature flow. If you can send the DocuSign I will route to our finance approver and we can target the Sept 5 activation you mentioned.

Also confirming we accept the soft burst +20% for 90 days and the 3-step canary ramp you suggested. Please include the following in the MAP before signature: a rollback clause that states Redwood will support a two-week rollback to the prior commit if we observe >3% error rate regressions tied to the new throughput during the first 30 days.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Marta

--
Marta Rios
Head of Engineering, ScalePath
